get.description: Series history (addendum 9.13): `{window, step_s, from, to, series: [{key, label, points: [[ts, avg, max], ...]}], truncated}`. `keys` is a comma-separated list of 1..12 canonical metric keys (a bare key also matches its label variants). `15m` = the in-memory ring (raw points), `1h` and `24h` = 1-minute rollups, `7d` = 10-minute buckets (avg weighted by sample count, max of maxes). `split=1`: one series per label variant with its labels parsed, at most 32 per key (`truncated`).

schema.title: Response Metrics Series Api V1 Systems  System Id  Metrics Series Get

get.description: DCGM fleet history (addendum 9.14; DCGM only, every other system answers 404): `{metric, unit, window, step_s, from, to, rows: [{host, job, gpu, model, points: [[ts, value], ...]}], truncated}` for every GPU of the configured `dcgm_prometheus_jobs`, from Prometheus `query_range` (step 60 / 300 / 1800 s for 1h / 24h / 7d). The PromQL comes from a fixed table per metric. At most 64 rows, ordered by host then GPU. Prometheus down: 200 with `rows: []` and `problem: {code, message}`. Cached 30 s per (metric, window).
